verbatim_excerpt: Novo Nordisk launched a multi-month subscription program for FDA-approved Wegovy, available beginning March 31, 2026, through Ro, WeightWatchers, LifeMD, with Hims & Hers, Sesame, and others to follow soon. For Wegovy pen injections (0.25 mg, 0.5 mg, 1 mg, 1.7 mg, 2.4 mg), patients can choose 3-, 6-, or 12-month subscriptions: 3-month subscription: $329/month, a savings of $240 per year; 6-month subscription: $299/month, a savings of $600 per year; 12-month subscription: $249/month, a savings of $1,200 per year.
